description: Executions whose expiry time equals either boundary timestamp are counted.

d.request: Count order executions with expirespot between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' (inclusive of both boundaries), grouped by account scope, where the execution links to an order owned by a valid user.
d.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope

b.request: Count order executions with expirespot values inclusively between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' that link to orders belonging to existing users, grouped by account scope.
b.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope
b.raw: Count order executions with expirespot values inclusively between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' that link to orders belonging to existing users, grouped by account scope.

a.request: For order executions that link to an order (`ordersmark` = `recordvault`) whose user exists (`userlink` = `userstamp`), and whose expiry time (`expirespot`, compared as text) is from '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' through '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', both endpoints included, how many executions are there for each account scope (`acctscope`)? Return the account scope and the count.
a.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope

c.request: Counting order executions that link to an order (`ordersmark` = `recordvault`) belonging to an existing user (`userlink` = `userstamp`), with an expiry time (`expirespot`, compared as text) between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', how many executions are there per account scope (`acctscope`)? Show the account scope and the count. Executions whose expiry time equals either boundary timestamp are counted.
c.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope;
